industries.operating_outcome: One focused product set helps crews protect finishes and turn equipment around faster.
industries.buyer: FBO, MRO, airport-facility, and aviation ground-support maintenance teams
industries.distinct_scope: Aircraft-adjacent and ground-support cleaning under OEM, airworthiness, ramp, FOD, and wastewater controls - not general plant degreasing.
industries.search_intent: Aviation GSE degreasing, MRO floor cleaning, and aircraft-compatible maintenance chemistry
industries.lead_task: Wash oil, grease, and exhaust grime from ground equipment and approved aircraft-area parts.

industries.materials: Aluminum alloy, stainless steel, painted steel, composites, sealants, and elastomers
industries.wastewater: Capture ramp and shop wash water; route oil-bearing waste through the airport's approved separator and discharge program.

trial_brief.title: Brewery CIP controlled-trial brief
trial_brief.objective: Plan a witnessed circuit trial and measurable release decision before any site-wide chemistry change.

compatibility_checks.gate: Confirm grade, finish, weld condition, existing damage, and site approval before circulation.
Record exact material, age, prior exposure, and manufacturer limits; coupon-test unknown components.

compatibility_checks.material: Pump seals, valve seats, and heat-exchanger gaskets
compatibility_checks.gate: Record each elastomer and gasket grade; replace unknown compatibility assumptions with a controlled coupon review.

industries.concentration: Current CIP directions use 0.5–1.5 L per 10 gal; select within that range from soil load, circuit volume, temperature, and a witnessed trial.
industries.process: Log make-up concentration, return temperature, turbulent flow, circulation time, conductivity, rinse pH, and visual condition at the return.
industries.boundary: Isolate the circuit, verify 316 stainless/PVC/gasket compatibility, prevent cross-connections, and keep cleaning separate from the facility's validated sanitizing step.
industries.verification: Rinse-return pH and conductivity at baseline, no visible soil at inspection points, plus the plant's ATP, allergen, or microbiological release test.
industries.materials: 316 stainless steel, PVC, approved hoses, pump seals, valve seats, and heat-exchanger gaskets
industries.wastewater: Neutralize and discharge only within the site's pretreatment permit, pH limits, organic loading controls, and volume schedule.

industries.label: Construction
industries.headline: Match cement, form oil, and exterior staining to the right mechanism.
industries.marketing: HCR or Descaler breaks down cement and mineral residue, CR HD removes form oil, and LAM3 keeps working on outdoor stains.
industries.operating_outcome: Get cleaner tools and equipment without adding extra work for the crew or wash-water pickup.
industries.lead_task: Remove cement residue, form oil, and outdoor stains from tools, forms, equipment, and fleet vehicles.
industries.asset: Concrete pumps, forms, mixers, hand tools, compact equipment, vehicle exteriors, and finished masonry
industries.soil: Cement film, form oil, hydraulic grease, asphalt transfer, rust, and mineral efflorescence
industries.method: Clear loose material first, apply the right cleaner, brush where needed, and rinse with low pressure
industries.concentration: Choose the weakest current-label dilution that removes the identified cement, oil, or mineral soil after a hidden-area compatibility test.
industries.process: Record surface temperature, controlled wet dwell, brush or low-pressure agitation, and rinse volume; prevent mist and never dry-grind a chemical-cleaning residue.
industries.boundary: Follow silica controls, equipment OEM limits, coating compatibility, stormwater plans, and site containment. Do not acid-clean uncured or architecturally sensitive concrete without approval.
industries.verification: No visible cement or oily film, clean white-wipe where practical, acceptable finish in the test area, and documented wash-water recovery.
industries.materials: Carbon steel, aluminum, hydraulic seals, painted equipment, cured concrete, masonry, and form coatings
industries.wastewater: Collect slurry and wash water; settle solids and route liquid under the site's SWPPP and local discharge authorization.

industries.label: Data Centers

industries.operating_outcome: Compare restored flow and heat transfer, the final rinse, and time back online.
industries.lead_task: Clear scale from cooling equipment during planned maintenance without bringing cleaner near live IT equipment.
industries.asset: Cooling towers, plate heat exchangers, condenser-water piping, closed loops, strainers, and mechanical-room coils
industries.soil: Carbonate scale, iron oxide, corrosion product, silt, and water-side organic fouling
industries.method: Take the loop offline, circulate the cleaner, rinse fully, and restart the water treatment
industries.concentration: Set descaler concentration from the current label/user guide, deposit analysis, metallurgy, and loop volume; water-treatment dose remains site-engineered.
industries.process: Trend inlet/return temperature, flow, pressure drop, solution pH, iron or hardness response, contact time, agitation/recirculation, and rinse conductivity.
industries.boundary: Use MOP/SOP/EOP change control, redundancy approval, leak containment, LOTO, and zero open chemical work above live electrical or IT equipment.
industries.verification: Recovered approach temperature or pressure drop, stable rinse pH/conductivity, clean strainer inspection, and no leak or alarm after controlled restart.
industries.materials: Copper, stainless steel, carbon steel, aluminum coils, elastomers, treatment probes, and coated tower components
industries.wastewater: Capture spent cleanout solution; characterize metals and pH before routing through the facility's approved wastewater path.

trial_brief.title: Distribution / Cold Storage controlled-trial brief
trial_brief.objective: Plan a witnessed floor, dock, equipment, or isolated cold-room trial with documented recovery, dry-to-traffic, and wastewater routing before broader use.

compatibility_checks.gate: Confirm coating type, condition, floor temperature, and site approval; run the current hidden-area slip-residue and coating test before enlarging the trial.

compatibility_checks.material: Rubber tires, painted steel, stainless steel, and aluminum
compatibility_checks.gate: Confirm exact substrate, finish, and freezer or OEM limits; isolate traffic and powered equipment during the trial.
Confirm drain materials and the site's interceptor, pretreatment, and discharge schedule before routing recovered scrubber solution.

industries.concentration: Use the current low-foam or general-cleaning label range; start weak, increase only after a slip-residue and coating test.
industries.process: Log floor temperature, dilution, wet dwell, pad/brush agitation, recovery passes, final rinse, and dry-to-traffic time.
industries.boundary: Segregate food and packaging, isolate traffic and powered equipment, follow freezer/OEM limits, and do not represent cleaning as sanitizing.
industries.verification: No visible oil or tire film, dry white-wipe, facility slip-resistance check, clear drains, and release only after the floor is dry.
industries.materials: Sealed concrete, epoxy, urethane, rubber tires, painted steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and drain components
industries.wastewater: Recover scrubber solution; route grease and solids through the site's interceptor, pretreatment, and discharge schedule.

industries.distinct_scope: Tethered or payload-limited low-pressure application on inaccessible facades and steep roofs with flight, overspray, runoff, and public-zone controls - not conventional ground-access construction cleanup.
industries.search_intent: Drone facade cleaning, inaccessible roof washing, and tethered exterior-cleaning chemistry
industries.lead_task: Use low-pressure drone cleaning on roofs and facades while keeping overspray and runoff under control.
industries.asset: Roofs, façades, siding, glazing, solar modules, canopies, and elevated coated surfaces
industries.soil: Atmospheric soot, algae and mildew staining, bird residue, salt film, and loose particulate
industries.method: Test the cleaner at ground level, apply it with a calibrated low-pressure spray, give it time to work, and rinse when the surface needs it

trial_brief.title: Drone exterior cleaning controlled-trial brief
trial_brief.objective: Plan a future witnessed exterior-cleaning trial that records ground-level compatibility, aircraft and spray-system operating controls, runoff capture, and dry matched-angle acceptance before any broader use.

compatibility_checks.material: Coated metal, roofing membrane, and painted masonry
compatibility_checks.gate: Identify the exact coating or membrane, condition, repairs, and owner or manufacturer limits; approve the current ground-level finish test before any aerial application.
Record the exact glazing, sealant, and coating system; keep unlisted components outside the trial and accept only after the weakest current-label dilution dries without streak or finish change.
Map exposure and drainage before flight, establish exclusion and protection controls, and require the current ground-level runoff test before treating the planned area.

industries.concentration: Use the weakest current-label dilution that passes a ground-level finish and runoff test; never increase concentration to compensate for poor coverage.
industries.process: Record ambient/surface temperature, wind, nozzle flow, application rate, dwell, any rinse pass, flight path, and treated area.
industries.boundary: Follow aircraft and spray-system OEM limits, aviation rules, exclusion zones, overspray controls, landscaping protection, and electrical clearances.
industries.verification: Matched-angle before/after images after drying, no streak or residue, coating/gloss check, and complete runoff-capture record.
industries.materials: Coated metal, glass, roofing membrane, painted masonry, sealants, photovoltaic coatings, and landscaping
industries.wastewater: Map drainage before flight; block storm inlets and capture or divert runoff under the property permit.
